question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**approved**" means having received official authorization or consent. In this context, it refers to the crackers needing to be approved by the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO). (स्वीकृत)
 
• The other options: "**endorsed**," "**resumed**," and "**added**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *This meant that these crackers couldn't be loud beyond a certain limit and had to be approved__ by the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Endorsed (समर्थित):** Means to publicly or officially support someone or something. Although similar to approved, it implies public support which does not fit the regulatory context here.
 
• **Resumed (फिर प्रारंभ किया):** Means to begin again or continue after a pause. This does not fit the context of authorization.
 
• **Added (जोड़ा):** Means to include something. This does not fit the context of giving official approval.
